meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 当用户要求把项目历史做成每周摘要时，Claude 会先把完整时间线按 ISO 周切开，再按周顺序让每一章的“写手”分别读取上一章留下的剧情梗概，依次写出每章叙述，最后整理成有序的文件与目录索引。
howto.when: 当用户说出“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”等，或要求为某个项目生成逐周、连载式历史叙述时触发。

say.text: 把「项目名」从开始到现在的历史，做成每周一篇的连载摘要。
say.note: 会按 ISO 周拆分并逐章生成摘要。

say.text: 按 ISO 周拆分这个项目的整个时间线，逐周讲成连续故事。
say.note: 每周章节会承接上一周的剧情线索。

say.text: 为这个项目写一份逐周的叙述性周报，直到最后一周。
say.note: 最后一周会写「当前进展」收尾。

howto.what_en: When asked to turn a project's history into weekly digests, Claude splits the full timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs consecutive chapter writers—each reading the prior week's carry-forward block—to produce one narrative digest per week, delivered as ordered files with an index.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline', or 'narrative chapters' for a project's claude-mem history.

say_en.text: Make a week-by-week serial digest of this project's history from start to now.
say_en.note: Splits by ISO week and generates chapters in order.

say_en.text: Split the full timeline into ISO weeks and tell it as a continuous story.
say_en.note: Each chapter inherits the previous week's plot threads.

say_en.text: Write a per-week narrative digest for this project until the final week.
say_en.note: The final chapter ends with a 'Where We Are' section.
